description: Odd-one-out photo game GA47 for Rokid glasses: four set-ups (3 fruits + 1 stationery item, 3 tableware + 1 toy, 3 stationery + 1 kitchen tool, 3 shoes + 1 hat). Arrange four real items, call the odd position first (fixed before the photo), then snap: the host LLM lists the items left to right and reports the odd position (ODD), scored locally against the call. Camera only.
name: odd-one-out
